name: Event e Ikou! Sono 11

Go to a convention, and have sex with a cosplayer!
A must-see girl who becomes your favorite character, as though she's coming out of the product to you!

* This one is the final part about Battle V*xens, continued from 1, 7 and 9!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ148708.html]DLsite[/url]]
